cases.name: clean_input
cases.expected_behavior: Quality passes; selected model produces finite binary classification metrics.
cases.scoring_criteria: quality=passed, one holdout call, every scalar metric in [0,1]

cases.name: sealed_holdout
cases.expected_behavior: Threshold uses only validation rows; holdout remains separate and is evaluated once.
cases.scoring_criteria: selection_split=validation, overlap=0, validation hash matches partition, holdout_calls=1

cases.name: exact_duplicate_repair
cases.expected_behavior: Repair once, revalidate, then train on the original row count.
cases.scoring_criteria: repair_count=1, quality.rows equals original rows, one holdout evaluation

cases.name: invalid_labels
cases.scoring_criteria: attempt=0 and holdout_calls=0 and explicit rejection

cases.name: leakage_guard
cases.input: A fraud_probability column equal to the target is added
cases.expected_behavior: Drop label-generation probability and identifier columns before all experiments.
cases.scoring_criteria: No fraud_probability or *_id column appears in any trial feature list

cases.name: transient_recovery
cases.input: First specialist training attempt raises a controlled RuntimeError
cases.expected_behavior: Visit recovery agent once, retry same specialist, and complete.
cases.scoring_criteria: retries=1, first trial failed, second succeeded with same family, one holdout

cases.name: persistent_failure
cases.input: Every training attempt raises a controlled RuntimeError
cases.expected_behavior: Stop after the retry limit; do not score an unfitted model.
cases.scoring_criteria: two attempts, one retry, training_failed, zero holdout calls

cases.name: attempt_budget
cases.expected_behavior: Finalize the available model without another experiment.
cases.scoring_criteria: attempt=1, exactly one trial, one holdout call

cases.name: specialist_switch
cases.input: Clean sample with target validation F1 1.0
cases.expected_behavior: Below-target linear model routes to the tree specialist.

cases.name: known_signal
cases.input: Fixed synthetic fixture: 800 rows, class_sep=2.5, seed 123
cases.expected_behavior: Recover a clear predictive signal on sealed holdout.
